result.topic_en: Draft notes on the number of independent conditions satisfied by the branch values of a function, on algebraic equations between two variables sigma and sigma' with genus p, on the 3(p-1) moduli of classes of algebraic functions, on the inversion problem, and an interleaved draft of a letter to a doctor concerning publication of Riemann's investigations on Abelian functions.

Linear homogeneous relations among differentials at points (special divisor condition)
Count of moduli: 3(p-1) moduli for p>1, one constant for p=1
Differential equations equivalent to congruence of sums of Abelian integrals (inversion problem / Abel's theorem)
